features.name: Search and browse directory
features.detail: Millions of shows by name, topic, person; categories and charts
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ searches Apple's free iTunes directory (no key) and lists charts by country and category; any RSS link can be pasted

features.name: Show pages
features.detail: Description, episodes, ratings and reviews, related shows
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ show page: cover, author, description, episodes with dates, lengths and notes, follow, share, play latest, unplayed filter and sort. No ratings, reviews or related shows

features.name: Play episodes
features.detail: Stream with seek, skip back 15 / forward 30
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ player: play/pause, seek, back 15, forward 30, streaming straight from the publisher

features.name: Follow shows
features.detail: Follow; new episodes appear and can auto-download
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ follows kept on the device (60 at most), a New episodes list refreshed after load, OPML import and export. No auto-download

features.name: Up Next queue
features.detail: Queue, reorder, continue where you left off
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ queue: add, move up and down, remove, plays on when an episode ends

features.name: Playback speed
features.detail: 0.5x to 2x
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ speed 0.5x to 3x kept between visits

features.name: Resume position
features.detail: Remembers where you stopped across devices
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ the place in every episode kept on this device and resumed; not synced across devices

features.name: Transcripts
features.detail: Read-along transcripts, search in transcript, tap a line to jump
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ transcripts named by a feed (WebVTT, SubRip, JSON, HTML, text) with search and tap-a-line to jump; Verse Out Loud's own whole transcript

features.name: Charts
features.detail: Top shows and episodes by country and category
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ top podcasts by country (18) and category (19), Apple's public chart feeds

features.name: Chapters
features.detail: Chapter markers with art
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ chapters from the feed (Podcast Namespace JSON or Podlove inline), tap to jump, current one highlighted. No chapter art

features.name: Sleep timer
features.detail: Stop after time or end of episode
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ sleep timer: 5 to 60 minutes or end of episode

features.name: Played/unplayed and filters
features.detail: Mark played, hide played, sort
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ played and started marks, mark played or unplayed, unplayed-only filter, newest or oldest first

features.name: Downloads management
features.detail: Auto-download, storage limits, remove after play
features.verse_evidence: /podcasts/ Downloads: save episodes for offline in the Cache API (150 MB an episode, 1 GB in all, only where the publisher allows a web page to read its audio), list and remove. No auto-download, no remove-after-play

gaps: cross-device sync of follows and places (export OPML instead)
a live look at Apple's directory shapes (built against fixtures)
verse_extra: Verse makes its own podcast with a full transcript
jump to a moment from a line of the transcript
follows, places, queue and speed kept on the device with no account
OPML import and export of follows
Verse Out Loud pinned first, with its whole transcript
first_page: Podcast player page /podcasts/ for listeners who want any show without an account. First: search shows (iTunes Search, keyless) or paste an RSS link, episode list read from the feed through a small edge proxy, a player with speed, skip 15/30, resume position and a follow list kept on the device; Verse Out Loud pinned first. Will not build: paid subscriptions, recommendations, ratings or cross-device sync.
